question: _______ in economics is a curve that, when plotted on a graph, shows all the combinations of two factors that produce a given output.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Isoquant,__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **An isoquant **in economics is a curve that, when plotted on a graph, shows all the combinations of two factors that produce a given output.
 
• Often used in manufacturing, with capital and labour as the two factors, isoquants can show the optimal combination of inputs that will produce the maximum output at minimum cost.
 
• An isoquant is also called an equal product curve or production indifference curve or constant product curve.
 
• Isoquant curve shows combinations of inputs employable to produce a certain output. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Elasticity is **an economic concept used to measure the change in the aggregate quantity demanded of a good or service in relation to price movements of that good or service. **
 
• A product is considered to be elastic if the quantity demand of the product changes more than proportionally when its price increases or decreases.
 
• The long run refers to a **period of time where all factors of production and costs are variable.**
 
• Over the long run, a firm will search for the production technology that allows it to produce the desired level of output at the lowest cost.
 
• A duopoly exists when** two companies dominate a market for a given product or service.**
 
• A duopoly can have the same impact on the market as a monopoly if the two players collude on prices or output.
